items.text: Kosodete ikapolok luka ikalia luka lukapapaa luka Ilebin aikunyakin mama ejai Eleasar esasedoti, ka Yosua okoku loka Nun, ka ikapolok luka ikalia luka lukapapaa luka atekerin nuka idwe luka Isirael;
Kotemasi kes koSilo kakwap naka Kanaan atiar, “Abu EJAKAIT kicorak kama ka Musa ainakin sio ireria lukiboionono, ka ironyiakee kanuka ibarenekosi.”
Apotu idwe luka Isirael koinakisi Ilebin ireria lu ka ironyiakee kotoma airumetekec, kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT.
Kobeik eroet ikekia luka Ikokatin: kobeik eroet idwe luka Aaron esasedoti, luaraas Ilebin, kotoma ateker naka Yuda, ka ateker naka Isimeonin, ka ateker naka Benyamin, ireria itomon ka luuni,
Kobeik eroet idwe luka luedeuna luka Kokat kotoma okekia luka ateker naka Epuraim, ka ateker naka Dan, ka atutubet naka ateker naka Manase, ireria itomon.
Kobeik eroet idwe luka Gereson kotoma okekia luka ateker naka Isakar, ka ateker naka Aser, ka ateker naka Naputali, ka atutubet naka ateker naka Manase koBasan, ireria itomon ka luuni.
Kodumut idwe luka Merari kwape ajaatar ikekiakec kotoma ateker naka Reuben, ka ateker naka Gad, ka ateker naka Sebulun, ireria itomon ka luarei.
Koinakis idwe luka Isirael Ilebin ireria nul ka ironyiakee kailamilam eroet, kwape ecorakinitor EJAKAIT kama ka Musa.
Koinakis kotoma ateker naka idwe luka Yuda, ka ateker naka idwe luka Simeon, ireria lu luebilitai kane ikecekiroria,
Koraas luka idwe luka Aaron, luka ikekia luka Ikokatin, luaraas luka idwe luka Lebi: naarai abu eroet losodit kobeik kes.
Apotu koinakis kes Kiriat-araba, Araba ŋol ŋes papa loka Anak, (nopenol ŋes Keburon) kakwap nakiukon naka Yuda, ka ironyiake lualukunito.
Konye imanikoria luka ere ka ireriake ludidik, apotu kesi koinakis Kaleb okoku loka Yepune airum.
Apotu koinakis idwe luka Aaron esasedoti Keburon ka ironyiake, ere loekuianari ikaaran, ka Libuna ka ironyiake;
ka Yatir ka ironyiake, ka Esitemoa ka ironyiake;
ka Kolon ka ironyiake, ka Debir ka ironyiake;
ka Ain ka ironyiake, ka Yuta ka ironyiake, ka Bet-semes ka ironyiake, ireria ikanykaoŋon kotoma atekerin nun nuarei.
Kotoma ateker naka Benyamin, Gibeon ka ironyiake, Geba ka ironyiake;
Anatot ka ironyiake, ka Alumon ka ironyiake; ireria iwoŋon,
Ireria kere luka idwe luka Aaron, isasedotin, emwaasi itomon ka luuni ka ironyiakec,
Apotu ikekia luka idwe luka Kokat, Ilebin, kes idwe kere luedeuna luka Kokat, kodumut ireria luka eroetekec kotoma ateker naka Epuraim.
Apotu koinakis kes Sekem ka ironyiake kakwap nakiukon naka Epuraim, ere loekuianari ikaaran, ka Geser ka ironyiake;
ka Kibisaim ka ironyiake; ka Bet-koron ka ironyiake; ireria iwonon,
Kotoma ateker naka Dan, Eliteke ka ironyiake, Gibeton ka ironyiake;
Aiyalon ka ironyiake, Gatrimon ka ironyiake; ireria iwonon,
Kotoma atutubet naka ateker naka Manase, Taanak ka ironyiake, ka Gat-rimon ka ironyiake; ireria iarei.
Ireria kere luka ikekia luka idwe kere luedeuna luka Kokat emwaasi itomon ka ironyiakec.
Apotu koinakis idwe luka Gereson, loka ikekia luka Ilebin, kotoma atutubet naka ateker naka Manase, Golan koBasan ka ironyiake, ere loekuianari ikaaran, ka Be-esetera ka ironyiake; ireria iarei.
Kotoma ateker naka Isakar, Kision ka ironyiake, Daberat ka ironyiake,
Yaramut ka ironyiake; En-ganim ka ironyiake; ireria iwonon.
Kotoma ateker naka Aser, Misal ka ironyiake, Abudon ka ironyiake;
Kelekat ka ironyiake; ka Rekob ka ironyiake; ireria iwoŋon.
Kotoma ateker naka Naputali, Kedes koGalilaya ka ironyiake, ere loekuianari ikaaran, ka Kamot-dor ka ironyiake, ka Karutan ka ironyiake; ireria iuni.
Ireria kere luka Igeresonin kwape ajaatar ikekiakee emwaasi ireria itomon ka luuni ka ironyiakec.
Apotu koinakis ikekia luka idwe luka Merari, luedeuna luka Ilebin, kotoma ateker naka Sebulun, Yokoneam ka ironyiake, ka Karuta ka ironyiake,
Dimuna ka ironyiake, Nakalal ka ironyiake; ireria iwonon,
Kotoma ateker naka Reuben, Beser ka ironyiake, ka Yakas ka ironyiake;
Kedemot ka ironyiake, ka Mepaat ka ironyiake, ireria iwonon,
Kotoma ateker naka Gad, Ramot koGilead ka ironyiake, ere loekuianari ikaaran, ka Makanaim ka ironyiake;
Kesibon ka ironyiake, Yaser ka ironyiake, ircria kere iwcnon.
Ŋul kere araas ireria luka idwe luka Merari kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, kes luedeuna luka ikekia luka Ilebin; kobeikis kes ireria itomon ka luarei.
Ireria kere luka Ilebin kotoma airumeta nuka idwe luka Isirael emwaasi ireria akaisaoŋon ka lukanykauni ka ironyiakee.
Alukunito ireria ŋul ironyiakec: ekote nen ireria nul kere.
Kwaŋin koinak EJAKAIT Isirael akwap kere naeyapoikinit ainakin lukapapaakec: apotu kiruma ŋes, kiboioto kotoma.
Kisiyen EJAKAIT kes kowaitin kere, kwape ajaatar kere nueyapoikinit lukapapaakec: mam edio kalukasurupokee kere loabu kobwoik kes; abu EJAKAIT kijaik lukasurupokec kere akanikec.
Emamei akirot namam abu kodol kakiro nuejok nuabu EJAKAIT kolimokinite ekek loka Isirael; apotu kere kodoloto.
